title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
shortDescription: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern web development from scratch.
description: A complete beginner-friendly web development course covering the fundamentals of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design. Build real-world projects while learning modern development practices.

title: React JS From Beginner to Advanced
shortDescription: Master React components, hooks, state management and real-world projects.
description: Learn React.js step by step from fundamentals to advanced concepts including hooks, Context API, reusable components and API integration.

title: Next.js Full Stack Development
shortDescription: Build modern full-stack applications using Next.js and MongoDB.
description: Learn Next.js App Router, server components, API routes, authentication and MongoDB by building practical full-stack applications.

title: JavaScript Mastery
shortDescription: Build a strong JavaScript foundation with practical coding exercises.
description: Understand JavaScript fundamentals, ES6, arrays, objects, functions, asynchronous programming and DOM manipulation through practical examples.

title: UI/UX Design with Figma
shortDescription: Learn UI/UX design principles and create professional designs with Figma.
description: Learn user research, wireframing, design systems, prototyping and modern UI design using Figma.

title: Node.js & Express Backend Development
shortDescription: Build REST APIs and backend applications with Node.js and Express.
description: Learn Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, authentication, middleware and MongoDB integration by creating practical backend projects.

title: MongoDB Database Fundamentals
shortDescription: Learn MongoDB database design, CRUD operations and aggregation.
description: Understand MongoDB collections, documents, CRUD operations, queries, indexes and aggregation pipelines with practical exercises.

title: Git & GitHub for Developers
shortDescription: Learn Git and GitHub workflows used by professional development teams.
description: Learn Git basics, branches, commits, pull requests, merge conflicts and collaborative GitHub workflows.
